# Mission — Data-Only Movie Protocol

The Awtsmoos renews every frame while data names each vessel exactly;
Awtsmoos.com must render what an agent declares, never guess what human language means indirectly.

## Non-negotiable invariant

The movie maker must never parse, classify, infer, or interpret English or any other natural language.

External AI agents or ordinary programs create explicit canonical movie data. The movie maker only:

1. migrates versioned data,
2. validates it,
3. normalizes mechanical defaults,
4. applies explicit machine patches,
5. projects it through app adapters,
6. previews/renders/exports it.

No prompt-to-movie fallback, regex semantics, keyword cameras, prose feature inference, or internal AI provider abstraction belongs inside the movie maker.

## Completion gates

- Public API exposes a stable machine-authored contract.
- UI accepts/imports canonical JSON/data instead of prose prompts.
- Revisions are explicit patch arrays/data only.
- App installers do not inject AI providers.
- Prompt/NLP modules are not reachable from the public movie runtime.
- Tests prove arbitrary structured movie data renders without any text interpretation.
- Existing 2D/3D adapters, three-minute showcase, mobile UX, export, and validation remain working.
